response.justification: Bogdan has strong backend and distributed-systems experience, including microservices, event-driven architectures, and real-time systems, which aligns well with the fintech and agentic AI requirements. His work on AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq and low-latency applications at Dunnhumby is promising. However, he lacks direct experience with multi-agent AI systems in production, fintech infrastructure (e.g., credit risk, payments), and scaling engineering teams to 30+ people. His background is more generalist and lacks the depth in AI-native fintech integration required for this role.
strengths: Strong backend and distributed-systems expertise (microservices, event-driven systems, real-time performance)
Experience with AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling (MCP, agentic workflows)
Proven track record scaling engineering teams and implementing disciplined practices (CI/CD, TDD, trunk-based development)
concerns: No demonstrated experience building or operating multi-agent AI systems in production contexts
Limited exposure to fintech-specific domains (credit risk, payments, embedded finance)
Lacks direct experience scaling engineering teams beyond 10-15 people or governing hybrid models with external partners
